game.name: Dodonpachi Daioujou Black Label Extra (Japan)
game.desc: DoDonPachi Daioujou Black Label Extra is a shoot'em up for Xbox 360. The title features 2D vertical scrolling gameplay, huge explosions, massive bosses and an arcade view. The Xbox 360 version differs from the original version in its enhanced graphics, downloadable content and online leaderboards. The game is also optimised for HD display.
